units.source_text: “我今天去了，对占卜师说他已经七十五岁，是老人病。

en.t: “I went today and told the fortune-teller that he was already seventy-five years old, and that it was an old person’s illness.

units.source_text: 他只是一个劲地吃，已经三十天没有大便了，请来给他看一看吧。

en.t: He only keeps eating, and he has not had a bowel movement for thirty days, so please come and have a look at him.

units.source_text: 占卜师说，毕竟是上了岁数，可能随时会发生意外，

en.t: The fortune-teller said that, after all, he was getting on in years, and something unexpected might happen at any time,
and that it was an illness of old age.”
